activity-log: Shows who changed what in the system and when, filterable by log type. Used to investigate disputes and mistakes.
agent: Small helper that fetches the agent (rider) list for dropdowns in other screens. Has no pages of its own.
agents: Riders: onboarding applications, profiles, attendance, holidays, salary and commission types. Used by ops and HR.
all-invoices: One list of every merchant invoice with both payable and receivable status, plus CSV and PDF downloads. Finance view.
assign-run: Scan baskets or orders and attach them to an agent's run before it leaves the hub.
authentication: SSO login, hub switcher, logout and impersonation for Carrybee staff. Picks which hub the user works in.
basket: Sealed bags of parcels that move between hubs as one unit. Create, print the basket label, track status from created to received.
business-insights: Management dashboard: agent productivity, delivery attempt outcomes, churned merchants, customer-service dispatch and other KPIs.
business-stores: Staff create or edit a merchant's pickup stores, change the store's hub and set the default pickup store.
businesses: Master list of seller businesses: service configuration, fees, KAM assignment (also by CSV), pending payout changes.
central-pod-print: Bulk printing of POD labels for orders at the central warehouse.
central-sorting: At the central warehouse, scan parcels, fix their last-mile hub if wrong, and pack them into outgoing baskets.
cluster: Groups of hubs under a cluster lead. Part of the region → cluster → hub tree.
custom-invoice: Generate one-off merchant invoices outside the regular cycle, with a payment summary.
customer-return-run: Reverse pickup trips: an agent collects items from buyers to send back to sellers.
delivery-allowance: Distance-based pay for agents. Approved amounts are paid out with an OTP step.
delivery-orders: Parcels at the last-mile hub waiting to go out. Move them between zones or to another hub.
delivery-run: The core last-mile screen: build an agent's delivery trip, scan parcels in, mark lost or damaged, count cash and close (or force close) the run.
discount-requests: Requests to lower a merchant's price plan, waiting for approval.
fraud-activities: Merchants report fraudulent buyers by phone number. Ops review and approve or reject the reports.
g-mode: Admin repair tools: reopen runs, reset OTP or agent throttling, approve urgent requests, regenerate invoices, impersonate users.
generate-invoice: Create the seller payout invoices from delivered orders, as regular or positive-balance invoices, filtered by KAM.
geonix: Draw and view delivery zone boundaries on a map, per city and hub. Backed by the geonix service.
hub-dashboard: Per-hub money overview: transaction history and reconciliation entries.
hub-ledger: How much cash each hub holds (cash in hand) and carries forward.
hub-payment-approvals: Finance reviews each hub's cash deposit and approves it, one by one or in bulk.
hub-payment-not-submitted: Hubs that collected COD but have not deposited it yet.
hub-payments: A hub submits the COD it collected, minus expenses and money lost, with proof of deposit.
hub-performance: Operational scorecard per hub: backlog, open runs, delivery attempts, agent productivity, zone transfers.
hub-pickup: When a seller brings parcels to the hub instead of waiting for a rider. Verified by OTP, entered manually or by scan.
incomplete-orders: Orders missing data needed to move them on. Fixed in bulk per hub.
kam-postpaid-invoice: Receivable invoices for postpaid key accounts, seen by KAMs. Menu entry is currently hidden.
kam-prepaid-invoice: Receivable invoices for prepaid key accounts, seen by KAMs. Menu entry is currently hidden.
landlord: Owners of rented hub premises, used for paying rent through petty cash.
linehaul: Trunk routes that connect hubs and sorting centres. Master data used by transfer runs.
lost-order: Record a parcel as lost and decide who pays compensation: the agent, the hub, or Carrybee.
merchant-profiles: Seller identity documents and profile details, reviewed by ops.
merchants: Create corporate merchants and set their business category.
missing-extra-parcels: Differences found when a basket is received by scan: parcels that should be there but aren't, or arrived unexpectedly.
no-entry-orders: Parcels physically at a hub with no matching order in the system. Create the order, process it, or return it.
notifications: Staff in-app notification list and dropdown.
on-demand: Sellers asking to be paid now instead of waiting for the regular payout cycle. Finance approves the requests.
order-processing: At the hub where parcels arrive: weigh, sort or unsort per store, view the consignment log. Statuses delivery/return sorted and unsorted.
order-status-change: Bulk-change order statuses when the normal flow can't. Restricted tool.
orders: Search any order and see its full details, parcel, products and history. Shared by many other modules.
paid-invoice: Merchant invoices that have been paid out. Read and export.
payable-consignments: Delivered orders whose COD is ready to be deposited or paid out, with summary totals.
pending-payments: Sellers' requests to change their bank or wallet payout account, waiting for approval.
pending-stores: New seller stores waiting for approval. Approve, reject, or change the assigned hub.
petty-cash: Hub expenses and rent. Each claim goes through ops head → HR → audit → accounts approval, then is withdrawn by OTP.
pickup-order: Orders waiting to be collected, grouped by store and route. Assign them to a pickup agent manually.
pickup-requests: Seller requests to collect N parcels from a store. KAMs can also create them for their accounts.
pickup-run: An agent's trip to collect parcels from seller stores and bring them to the hub. Create, add stores, close.
price-plans: Delivery fees, extra charges, price slabs and discounts for a merchant business.
processing-invoice: Merchant invoices being paid: export the bank Excel file, tag RTGS, process one by one or in bulk.
ptn: Rack setups with 12 or 24 pigeon holes mapped to hubs or linehauls, plus rack and basket labels. Used at sub-sort centres.
push-notification-center: Send push notifications to users from the panel.
qc: Reviewers approve or reject agents' requests to change an order's outcome, and spot fake requests by hub or agent.
qr-campaign-management: Referral QR codes and short links for acquiring new sellers, with visit counts.
rating-management: Customer and merchant ratings of agents, with hub summaries and weekly trends.
receivable-postpaid-invoices: Money postpaid sellers owe Carrybee. Includes monthly invoice generation.
receivable-prepaid-invoices: Money prepaid sellers owe Carrybee, with submission of their payments.
reconciliation: Approval chain for agent allowances and expense claims: cluster lead → region lead → HR → audit → accounts.
region: Top level of the organisation tree. Each region has a lead and a set of clusters.
reports: CSV exports: consignments, baskets, merchants and custom reports.
return-orders: Parcels heading back to sellers. Pack them into return baskets, transfer between zones or hubs.
return-run: An agent's trip that hands returned parcels back to sellers.
route: A hub's set of zones with a default agent, for pickup, delivery or reverse pickup.
run-not-closed: Delivery runs that were never closed, so their cash is not yet accounted for.
store-location-verification: Verify that a seller store's map location matches its address.
transfer-run: Moves baskets between hubs. Scan baskets in or out, hand over, receive by scan, print the gate pass, close.
unpaid-invoice: Merchant invoices generated but not yet paid. Export the bank Excel and move them into processing.
user-attendance: Check-in and check-out widget for staff, with attendance history.
users: Staff accounts, teams, departments, roles and permission scopes for hive.
wallet-provider: Banks (with branches) and mobile wallets that sellers can be paid into.
warehouses: Hubs and the delivery area tree: city → zone → area → sector. The most imported module in hive.

agent-messaging: Real-time chat between the seller and the delivery agent about a parcel (Centrifugo).
agent-rating: Seller or buyer rates the pickup or delivery agent.
analytics: Seller's order trends, overall statistics and top stores.
authentication: Register with phone, verify OTP, log in with password, reset password, impersonation for support staff.
businesses: Create or switch between the seller's businesses, edit the business profile and request pickups.
customers: Seller's buyer list, plus a fraud checker: look up a buyer's phone and file fraud reports.
dashboard: Home screen: order progress, payment summary, dues banner, on-demand withdrawal, ads.
faq: Help questions and answers for sellers.
high-alert: Things the seller must act on: urgent approvals from agents, partial deliveries, returns, no-entry parcels, last-mile issues.
invoices: Seller's payout statements: collected COD minus delivery and COD fees, with breakdown and export.
merchant: The seller's personal profile, ID documents (NID, birth certificate) and password change.
operators: Staff the seller adds to the business, as operator or accountant.
orders: Create orders (single, bulk, AI/OCR, reverse pickup, exchange), track them, edit or cancel, print labels, public tracking page.
payments: Set the payout account (bank or mobile wallet) and schedule, and pay dues to Carrybee via bKash, Nagad or SSLCommerz.
pickup-requests: List of past pickup requests with how many parcels were actually picked and sorted.
stores: Seller's pickup and return addresses on a map, each tied to a hub and route. Set the default store.
webhook: API credentials, webhook setup and API docs for sellers integrating their own systems.

authentication: Phone + OTP login for finance and legal staff.
business: Read-only list of seller businesses with fees, payout frequency, KAM and wallet.
departments: Dropdown data only. No page of its own.
hubs: Dropdown data only. No page of its own.
invoice: Merchant invoices for accounting, exported as CSV or PDF, per merchant or per order.
legal-order: Order and fee export for the legal team, filterable by parcel type.
merchants: List of sellers and their identity verification status.
reports: Consignment CSV report. Custom and merchant reports exist but are hidden.
teams: Dropdown data only. No page of its own.
users: User list. Its page does not exist yet.
